input: The product shape is settled. Create its runnable technical project baseline and GitHub repository.
expected: Use Setup, choose unspecified stable technical details, verify the complete baseline, and follow the authorized initial-delivery contract; do not route to Plan or business implementation.

input: Upgrade the framework and resolve every compatibility change caused by that update.
expected: Use one Setup delivery for the version, lockfile, required compatibility code/tests/migrations and affected versioned engineering sources. Apply the target’s durable knowledge rules at the appropriate delivery point.

input: A narrower installed platform setup skill exactly matches the requested native project shell.
expected: Prefer the narrower capability; do not impose a generic platform profile or require both skills.

input: Root AGENTS.md declares a Semina projectId and the assigned task has a linked module. The checkout is a worktree.
expected: Use the declared ID directly via MCP. Read the task, the decision cards it references and, when needed, its module and relevant pitfalls. Skip project enumeration and verify engineering facts from repository sources.

input: Root AGENTS.md points to repository architecture and test docs and declares no external provider.
expected: Use the stated repository sources and gates. Proceed without Semina registration or generating another context file.

input: An implementation request has no discoverable verification command.
expected: Investigate existing project entry points and ask only for the material missing verification fact; do not fabricate a passing check.

input: The existing AGENTS.md explicitly points to ProjectContext.md while the project awaits migration.
expected: Follow the declared legacy source for relevant context and preserve authored files and protected-edit rules.

input: A small fix has settled acceptance and no task card.
expected: Implement directly: no task card, no required card reads; at wrap-up record only a reusable pitfall or changed decision, with its link.

input: The user starts a design discussion with Plan in a repository whose AGENTS.md declares a Semina projectId.
expected: Read the project card first, search for related decisions, pending cards and open tasks, and mention only those relevant to the topic; do not force a module or list the inventory.

input: During Plan the user says the direction is settled.
expected: Before any work starts, turn the pending card into a decision (or update the decision), mark superseded cards with supersededBy, create or update the task card referencing those decisions with reviewer acceptance criteria, and send every card link.

input: The user signals the Plan discussion is wrapping up.
expected: Ask what comes next without a fixed menu; do only what the user picks, such as stopping, a ready implement prompt, dispatching a Worker or implementing here.

input: Mid-implementation a change needs several decisions across multiple PRs.
expected: Suggest switching to Plan and let the user decide; keep the worktree and resume the same delivery afterwards.

input: A task-card PR has independent approval and is about to merge.
expected: Compare the final diff with the referenced decision cards and module card, update them in place with links before merge, then complete the task with knowledgeImpact after the last PR merges.

input: The exact-head entry declares Semina, but the independent read-only reviewer cannot use MCP from its runtime.
expected: Use scoped private review evidence with the MCP read time, IDs, revisions and readable bodies. Compare it with exact-head instructions and the PR's acceptance, escalate material gaps, and keep publication and provider writes outside the reviewer’s role.

input: A repository reviewer already watches ready PRs.
expected: Reuse the reviewer already assigned to this PR; do not launch a competing owner. Migrate legacy repository watches only after their outstanding claims are settled.

input: Behavioral work requires independent review but no reviewer path is available.
expected: Start the supported independent PR reviewer automatically after PR creation. If execution is unavailable, report inactive review; do not self-approve or pretend another account is independent judgment.

input: The repository’s declared context source requires a separate PR and human approval to edit.
expected: Retain the separate PR and human approval requirements for that protected source.

input: No author monitor is installed.
expected: Report automatic follow-up unavailable; targeted active queries are allowed, but do not promise future wakeups.

input: More feedback arrives after an earlier state delivery and a new commit is pushed.
expected: Refetch the current state, fix accepted feedback and push, and reply with reasons only where disagreeing; a push alone is not resolution and no acknowledgement is required.

input: PR is approved but project requires the human to merge.
expected: Do not merge automatically; report the required human action.

input: Plugin is installed in a new cache directory with no infrastructure sibling.
expected: Both skills and shared references remain accessible; no private workspace path or iOS plugin is needed.

input: An existing correct test already proves one accepted case.
expected: Reuse and label/map it rather than duplicate it or mutate correct behavior to force Red.

input: A task card includes UI acceptance but no UI automation was requested.
expected: Prioritize unit-testable cases, report UI evidence as pending/user-owned, and do not add CI UI jobs or claim UI acceptance from unit results.

input: An implementation PR satisfies its current accepted scope but changes behavior shipped by several earlier PRs.
expected: Do not report the historical mismatch as a finding by itself; review against the acceptance bound to this PR, current repository rules and unintended behavior outside the accepted change.

input: The current work has no task card. The user directly requests a visual or interaction adjustment that changes behavior delivered by an older PR.
expected: Use the user's current request as acceptance and proceed through Implement with appropriate human UI acceptance; do not require Plan.

input: The current work has no task card. The user requests offline sync but leaves a conflict outcome undefined, so implementation and verification cannot determine the expected result.
expected: Ask only for the missing conflict outcome as a direct clarification, then use the request and answer as acceptance; do not require Plan or a task card.

input: An accepted Issue names the file and a suggested fix, but the current caller has changed.
expected: Batch the named code, relevant tests and gates, verify the diagnosis, then expand to the changed caller; do not blindly apply the suggestion or restart broad discovery.

input: A direct small regression fix has adequate existing scenario tests with descriptive names and no task card.
expected: Map outcomes to those names in one task/PR record; do not create synthetic clause IDs or rename tests solely for tracing.

input: A two-line session revocation change has an exact diagnosis and passing gates.
expected: Use independent Sol/Opus high review because authentication risk outweighs diff size; gates remain unchanged.

input: A well-understood bounded fix has verified diagnosis, known dependencies, meaningful coverage and no sensitive or uncertain impact.
expected: The independent reviewer may use Luna max or Sonnet max through deterministic complexity; preserve exact-head approval and all gates.

input: The delivery helper returns native-monitor-required on Claude.
expected: Use the persistent native Monitor tool, then repeat start for the exact PR; never detach Bash as a notification substitute or claim reviewer startup prematurely.

input: The same reviewer is supplied as both a native transcript and CLI usage summaries.
expected: Reject overlapping accounting instead of adding both, and report unavailable request counts as unknown.

input: This implementation session has Semina task card T and the first of two PRs has just merged.
expected: Read semina-bound.md; keep the task in_progress for the second PR, and set completed with knowledgeImpact only after the last PR merges and acceptance is met.

input: A coordinator dispatched this session in chat to implement a task card and said it keeps the card's status.
expected: Leave task status to the coordinator, but still record approved direction changes and align the referenced decision and module cards with the final diff after approval and before merge.

input: Implement image upload with a new direct dependency, matching manifest and lockfile changes.
expected: Keep these changes in one Implement PR, disclose each dependency change and update affected versioned engineering docs in that PR. Apply the declared provider’s authorized knowledge updates at the appropriate delivery point. Reviewers do not require a separate Setup PR or block on dependency presence.

input: Remove a feature and its unused dependency, which is referenced in the engineering documentation.
expected: Remove the feature, dependency, matching manifest/lockfile entries and affected documentation references in one Implement PR. Disclose the dependency removal.

input: Plan a feature that needs a new direct dependency but no other missing foundation.
expected: Include the dependency and matching manifest/lockfile changes in Implement scope without a separate Setup prerequisite.
